# Keratoscope

A browser-based astigmatism ghosting calibration wizard.

- Live: https://markkirby125.github.io/keratoscope/
- Repo: https://github.com/markkirby125/keratoscope
- License: MIT

## What it is

A single-page, client-only tool that helps people who see ghosted or doubled text generate a personal CSS userstyle. The wizard anchors the adjustment to real text, then exports a deterministic, script-free CSS block for Stylus or another userstyle manager.

## What it is not

- Not a medical device.
- Not a diagnosis or vision correction.
- Not a guarantee of reduced ghosting.

The copy promise everywhere is: "a presentation tweak that may reduce perceived doubling for some users — no guarantee."

## Safety prompt

The first screen asks: "New or sudden double vision? See an eye professional today." The user must acknowledge before continuing.

## Tech stack

- Vanilla JavaScript (ES modules)
- Single `index.html` for the wizard, preview, and export
- `profile.js` for profile model and deterministic CSS generation
- Node built-in test runner for CSS snapshot tests
- GitHub Pages for deployment

## Local usage

```bash
git clone https://github.com/markkirby125/keratoscope.git
cd keratoscope
npm test
```
